summary: Comprehensive testing of Data Integrity Audit, CRM CSV Import, Client/Lead Filters, and Cascade Delete features. All 22 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI features verified working as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created test items, projects, leads, and clients prefixed with 'TEST_ITER20_' - all cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features are working correctly: Data integrity audit returns 0 orphaned records after cleanup, CRM CSV import works with duplicate detection, CRM filters (status/source for leads, search/type for clients) work on frontend, cascade delete for items and projects working correctly.

data_integrity_audit.notes: Returns orphaned_checkouts, orphaned_issues, orphaned_lost_items, orphaned_maintenance, quantity_mismatches counts. Admin-only access enforced.

data_integrity_cleanup.notes: Removes orphaned records. Admin-only access enforced. After cleanup, total_orphaned = 0.

dashboard_data_integrity_widget.notes: Dashboard shows 'All clear - zero data leakages detected' message with green checkmark for admin users.

cascade_delete_item.notes: Deletes item and cascades to checkouts, issues, lost_items, maintenance. Response includes cascade counts.

cascade_delete_project.notes: Deletes project and cascades to checkouts, lost_items. Response includes cascade counts.

delete_item_block_active_checkouts.notes: Returns 400 error 'Cannot delete item with active checkouts' when trying to delete item with active checkouts.

crm_csv_import.notes: Accepts multipart/form-data with 'file' field. Creates leads, detects duplicates by email, reports errors for rows without name.

crm_lead_filters.notes: Frontend has Status and Source dropdown filters on Leads tab. Backend returns status and source fields for client-side filtering.

crm_client_filters.notes: Frontend has Search input and Type filter dropdown on Clients tab. Search covers company_name, contact_person, email, phone, address, industry.

crm_dashboard_stats.notes: Returns leads_this_month, conversion_rate, pipeline_value, total_clients, at_risk, needs_attention, by_status, by_source breakdowns.

crm_lead_crud.notes: Lead creation with scoring, status updates, activity logging all working.

crm_client_crud.notes: Client creation, onboarding checklist toggle updates working.
